Level1: Based on quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical financial assets and liabilities.
Level2: Based on inputs other than quoted prices included within Level i that are observable for the financial asset or liability,either directly (i.e.as unquoted prices)or indirectly (i.e.derived from prices).
Level3: Based on inputs not observable in the market using appropriate valuation models,including discounted cash flow modelling.
